name: NY-25
label: Safe D

key_factors: District leans Democratic by 10 points on party registration/previous results
Incumbent Joseph Morelle running with a large fundraising edge ($1.8M vs $32K)
No outside spending against Morelle and no public polling
Prediction markets price Democratic win at ~97%
model.rationale: Morelle combines a 10-point Democratic district lean, incumbency, and an overwhelming financial advantage against a barely funded challenger, with no outside opposition spending. Markets and fundamentals both point to a comfortable double-digit win.
model.watch: A late surge in national Republican spending or an unusually favorable GOP environment could narrow the margin, though a seat flip remains very unlikely.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Joseph Morelle, the Democratic incumbent, seeks another term in a Rochester-area district that leans about 10 points Democratic. He has raised roughly $1.8 million and holds over $400,000 in cash, while Republican Virginia McIntyre has raised about $32,000 with minimal cash on hand. No outside groups are spending against Morelle, and no public general-election polling is available for the race.

Prediction markets put Morelle's chances near 97 percent, and the fundamentals point to a comfortable double-digit margin. With no expert ratings or polls to refine the picture, uncertainty is somewhat elevated, but every available signal favors the incumbent retaining the seat.
